review_scope: Packet-only independent semantic review of the R09 candidate for DOCX 0095 / I18-E02. All findings derive solely from the packet-supplied current R09 Word-exported PDF text (43 pages), the supplied R08 replacement-register CSV body, the supplied register manifest, the Unique Blueprint and source binding, the R08 exact-SHA review outcome, and the deterministic R06/R08 register key-set reconciliation. No shell, filesystem, browser, GUI, DOCX-binary rehash, PDF re-render, or visual inspection was performed or claimed. The DOCX SHA-256 e1be4a9e…0ed8e is bound as the review target exactly as supplied by the packet and was not independently rehashed. This review assesses semantic content only; it is not a TTQS assessment, not a score, and not formal association acceptance. The candidate remains CANDIDATE.

criteria.criterion: 2. All Unique Blueprint sections, required tables/figure/analysis, questions, calculations, direct usability and acceptance tests
criteria.finding: All thirteen Blueprint required_sections are present and substantively populated: 摘要/決策問題 (§1.1), 官方要求 (§1.2–§1.3), 來源樣本納入排除 (§2.4, §3.2, §5.1, §6.1–§6.2), 指標定義與分母 (§5.1–§5.2), 完整示範資料與逐步計算 (§6.1–§6.4.1), 分群/趨勢/差異 (§7.1–§7.2), 圖表解讀與品質限制 (§7.2 附圖 A, §7.3), 發現原因與證據強度 (§1.3, §7.3, §8.4), 結論與建議 (§8.4–§8.5), 責任/期限/追蹤指標 (§8.5, PDF pp.37–38), 合成聲明與替換清單 (§9.5, §10), 附件索引/覆核/版本 (§10.1–§10.2). All five required table/figure families are present, including 附圖 A as a fully specified two-panel figure with title, per-panel values, same 0–100% axis, presentation rules, warnings and alt-text draft (PDF pp.33–34). Per the packet instruction, the absence of an encoded figure object in PDF text was not treated as a missing chart. All ten required_questions are answered with explicit denominators, sources, nonresponse handling, attribution boundary, direct-evidence location, evidence-strength ladder (4.25–4.26), calculation precision and N/A conditions. All three required_calculations are implemented and recomputed (see material_arithmetic_checks) and the result is never framed as association performance. Genre-specific usability is satisfied: questionnaires carry items/options/scale (PDF pp.12, 16), the SOP carries role/input/control/output/hold-reject (PDF pp.7–8), the meeting-record role is carried as 審閱／決策紀錄 and 版本與調閱記錄 outputs with decisions, responsibility, deadline and status columns (§8.5, PDF p.37), and the report carries data, denominators, formulae, step-by-step arithmetic, limits and decisions. Acceptance tests are met on the text-only evidence available; typography floors, column fit and actual figure rendering are outside the packet-only scope and are carried in unknowns, not as defects.

criteria.finding: Every displayed quantity was independently recomputed from the raw rows printed in §6.1/§6.2/§6.4 and all reproduce exactly (see material_arithmetic_checks). Counts reconcile: learners 18 invited = 15 returned + 3 nonresponse; 15 returned = 14 valid + 1 invalid (missing L-05); customers 6 invited = 5 returned + 1 nonresponse; 5 valid. Item sums 57/56/55/56/58 and 21/20/20/21/21, means 4.07/4.00/3.93/4.00/4.14 and 4.20/4.00/4.00/4.20/4.20, positive counts 11/11/10/11/12 and 4/4/4/4/4, positive rates 78.6/78.6/71.4/78.6/85.7 and 80.0 across, and 100.0/93.3/83.3/83.3/100.0 rate set all match. Ranking is reproducible under the stated rule (positive rate ascending, then mean ascending, dense ranking): learner P1 L-03, P2 L-02 and L-04, P3 L-01, P4 L-05 with gaps 14.3/7.1/7.1/0.0 percentage points and 0.21/0.14/0.07/0.00 points; customer P1 C-02 and C-03, P2 C-01, C-04, C-05. The §7.2 sensitivity scenario (excluding SYN-L14's 2-point L-03 response) recomputes exactly: n=13, sum 53, mean 4.08, 10/13 = 76.9%, gap narrowing to 8.8 points and 0.07 points, and L-03 remains P1. Follow-up figures reproduce: 51, 4.25, 85, 7.08, Δ_abs 2.83, Δ_rel 66.7%, 9/12 = 75.0%. The §6.4 pairing boundary (14 valid = 12 paired + 2 unavailable, excluded from the paired denominator, not treated as failure) is correctly applied. N/A and missing rules (§4.3 p.19, §5.1 p.20, §5.2 p.22) are explicit and consistent, and the small-sample suppression rule n<5 is defined and applied to sub-groups with no sub-group data published. The §6.3.3 non-aggregation rule is honoured: learner and customer populations are reported on separate denominators with no pooled rate, and the §6.3.2 'valid returns as share of invitations' figure (5/6) is explicitly distinguished from the validity rate (5/5).

criteria.criterion: 5. Direct administration of both tools: eligibility, consent, scale, N/A, incomplete/withdrawn/invalid/valid status, REAL blank dates, invitation/delivery/return, population boundary, privacy/storage, aggregation and hold/reject criteria; proposed controls distinct from implemented operation
criteria.exact_locator: §4.1 PDF pp.10–13; §4.2 PDF pp.13–17; §3.1 SoD PDF p.6; §3.2 SOP P-01…P-10 PDF pp.7–8; 計數界線 blocks PDF pp.9, 13, 17, 22; §5.1 dictionary PDF pp.20–21; §8.1 PDF p.35; §8.3 PDF p.35; §6.3.3 PDF p.28
criteria.finding: Both instruments are directly usable as printed. Tool-A (SURVEY-TOOL-A-L) and Tool-B (SURVEY-TOOL-B-C) each carry a pre-response consent/notice block, a volunteer-participation statement, a field-zone legend separating SAMPLE values from REAL blanks, the 1–5 plus N/A scale legend, and an item matrix with a check column. Status handling is complete and mutually exclusive on both forms: 未回應（NONRESPONSE, with an instruction not to tick it and not to treat it as negative）, 撤回（WITHDRAWN）, 待補正之未完成（INCOMPLETE_PENDING_CORRECTION）, 無效（INVALID）, 有效（VALID）, each with a mutually-exclusive instruction, and a repeated 計數界線 block (PDF pp.13, 17) stating that nonresponse is logged only on the invitation/delivery roster, that every physically returned form counts once as POP_RETURNED regardless of downstream status, that withdrawn/incomplete/invalid forms do not enter POP_VALID or item denominators, and that corrections leave a trace. REAL date fields are blank with explicit format instructions (Tool-A: 班次編號, 培訓日期, 實際填答日期, PDF pp.10–11; Tool-B: 邀請發送日期, 送達日期, 實際填答日期, 回收日期, PDF p.15), and the sample date is fenced as SAMPLE with a no-backfill instruction. Invitation/delivery/return are separated at the counting-boundary level (PDF p.9) and in SOP step P-04 (PDF p.7). Population boundaries are defined per POP_ELIGIBLE / POP_INVITED / POP_RETURNED / POP_VALID (PDF p.20). Privacy and storage are left explicitly UNKNOWN with a candidate control list (§8.3, PDF p.35) rather than asserted. Hold/reject conditions are given per SOP step and consolidated in the §8.1 decision table (可計算 / 暫緩 / 排除單份 / 抑制次分群 / 不得升格 REAL, PDF p.35), including the rule that a single unapproved percentage may not auto-trigger a failure verdict or CAPA (PDF p.6). Every control is labelled 候選設計/提案 and marked as requiring authorised adoption; the document never asserts that any control, committee, role assignment, storage location or recovery channel is in operation, so the proposed/implemented boundary holds throughout.

The status declaration on p.1 states the document is a candidate analysis report with a complete SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC demonstration and that no source proves the association adopted, approved or executed it. No fabricated person, approval, signature, course, respondent, real survey execution, outcome or third-party record was found: the only named entities are the synthetic course 志工服務溝通與紀錄練習, class code SYN-TRN-01 and synthetic dates 2026-07-11 / 2026-08-10, all flagged as synthetic; §8.5's 建議負責人 field is blank with 『姓名未提供；UNKNOWN，不得填入推定人選』; the 感謝函 of 0096 is expressly not fabricated (§9.4). criteria.criterion: 7. Usability for a small volunteer association: SOP, data dictionary, worked case, ranked recommendations, decision criteria, responsibility/deadline/metric fields and follow-up; recommendations separate from authorization/execution
criteria.finding: Usability is high for a small volunteer body and does not assume a committee or dedicated data unit: the SoD matrix names four candidate functions (ROLE-CRD / COL / ANL / DEC) with an explicit scale-limitation fallback requiring an authorised alternative control, and states that no committee, CAPA or file-management process is implied (PDF p.6). The SOP provides ten steps with input, operation/control, output and hold/reject conditions, P-02 explicitly gating release on authorised tool approval, and P-01 gating on a known population and invitation denominator. The data dictionary gives eleven coded fields with denominator, numerator, source form and limits, including N/A and suppression rules, and the formula library gives six reproducible formulae with rounding and N/A guards. The worked case is complete and self-consistent end to end. Ranked recommendations exist at §7.2 (P1 L-03 for the learner track) with a documented ranking rule, an explicit decision criterion (positive rate 10/14, mean 3.93/5) and a sensitivity caveat. The tracking table separates 合成觀察 / 成因狀態 / 改善建議 / 後續核驗方式 / 建議責任職能 / 建議負責人 / 預定期限 / 狀態 into independent columns with fill rules ①–④ that forbid naming a person, forbid assumed deadlines and forbid writing 已改善 without verifiable follow-up data, plus a blank TRK- log table. The PDCA block adds hold/close criteria per stage, including a requirement to compare at least two options. Recommendations are consistently kept distinct from authorization: stage 4 requires verified decision authority, and every candidate proposal is marked as requiring authorised adoption with 實際指派未核定.

criteria.criterion: 8. Negative-neighbour and title-blind tests reject at least two wrong documents by concrete body-level fields/sections
criteria.exact_locator: §9.3 PDF p.38; §9.4 PDF p.38; §9.1 PDF p.38; §4.3 field mapping PDF pp.17–18; §3.2 SOP codes PDF pp.7–8; §1.4 PDF p.4
criteria.finding: Two wrong documents are rejected on body-level grounds, not labels. Against 0094 / I18-E01 (口述訪談紀錄), §9.3 identifies the distinguishing body content: 0094's artefact is an oral interview record with interview statements and interviewees, whereas 0095 carries dual-track structured instruments, item codes, a scale definition, a field dictionary, formulas, denominators and per-item rates, and the document expressly states it does not pass interview quotes, interviewees or real oral material off as its own survey results. Against 0096 / I18-E03 (感謝函), §9.4 identifies the distinguishing body content: 0096's artefact is a letter with an issuer, content and an original whose provenance must be verified, whereas 0095 is a mechanism analysis report, and the document states it must not impersonate, manufacture or backfill 0096's genuine original. In title-blind terms the two neighbours are rejected on concrete body fields a reader would have to see: SURVEY-TOOL-A-L / SURVEY-TOOL-B-C form codes, LEARN_*/CUST_* field names, P-01…P-10 SOP steps and ROLE-* function codes appear in no other document, while a 訪談逐字稿 or a 感謝函格式 (致受贈單位／敬啟者／署名) appears in none of them. The §9.1 four-document table further states the boundary is derived from official wording and Blueprint division of labour, and does not presume neighbours' real content.

r08_finding_disposition.rationale: R08-02 alleged an uncounted added key. The supplied R06/R08 key-set reconciliation shows SYN-0095-CUSTOMER_VALID_RETURN_SHARE is present in R06 and in R08 with the same fact_status, fact_type, value 83.3 and unit percent (only document_location gains the PDF p. 28 locator), so it is among the 205 retained keys and is neither an addition nor a retirement.
